sources.locator: PDF page 365, rows 24-46; visually checked against a 300 dpi render
sources.collection_name: Records of the Office of Strategic Services, Record Group 226
sources.rights_notes: Every printed row remains separate. Full protected identifiers remain private. The CAF-3 and CAF-4 grades, Charlotta Peterson's Also 120 note, the two Chester E Peterson rows, and the Petersen/Peterson spelling conflict are preserved without silent expansion, correction, or merger.

sources.title: Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File, ca. 1938-1946
sources.collection_name: Records of the Selective Service System, Record Group 147
sources.rights_notes: Official unrestricted bulk data, not a Catalog API response. Protected identifiers, coded occupations, and raw records are not published or retained. The John A Petersen/Peterson and Chester E Peterson/Andrew D Pedersen conflicts remain qualified and unresolved.
